tooltips.isConfidential: A confidential client authenticates with its client secret. A public client, such as a browser or mobile application, cannot keep a secret.
tooltips.clientCredentialsGrant: The client obtains an access token on its own behalf with its client ID and secret, without a user. It acts as the selected user.
tooltips.authorizationCodeGrant: The client obtains an access token on behalf of a user who signs in on the AtroCore sign-in page (with PKCE).
tooltips.refreshTokenGrant: Together with the access token the client gets a refresh token, which it exchanges for a new access token without signing the user in again.
tooltips.user: The user the client acts as when it obtains an access token with its own credentials (client credentials grant).

exceptions.userRequiredForClientCredentials: A client with the client credentials grant needs a user to act as.
exceptions.grantRequired: Select at least one way to obtain an access token: client credentials or authorization code.

actionConfirms.generateSecret: A new client secret will be generated. The current secret stops working and the tokens issued to the client are revoked. Continue?

actionResults.generateSecret: The client secret is shown only once, copy it now:
